message:
I was reminiscing about that one time I took a spontaneous road trip with the grandkids. We packed snacks, games, and even a playlist of our favorite songs, but somehow forgot the essentials like water and a first aid kit. It was a hilarious scramble to find a gas station that also sold band-aids! 

That little adventure reminded me how important it is to be prepared, especially when life takes us on unexpected journeys. I found a great resource that covers what to keep in your car for emergencies. It's a lighthearted reminder that a little planning can go a long way. Have you ever found yourself unprepared in a funny way?
